prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1304; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across the center and the left taillight assembly is broken, with the trunk lid showing a crease along its lower edge. The damage pattern lines up well with the impact that was described, and the surrounding panels show no conflicting marks. Repairs will involve replacing the bumper cover and taillight, straightening the trunk lid, and refinishing the rear quarter panel to match. The labor hours assigned to each task look reasonable for the work required. No prior damage to this vehicle is known, and the invoices reviewed contain no repeated charges.
